scheme_name: Input Assistance to Farmers for Taking up Fish Farming in Farm Ponds
other_conditions: The applicant must be a resident of Odisha.
The applicant must have a bank account in his/her name in Odisha.
The farm pond must have been excavated by the applicant.
The farm pond must have been excavated under Government schemes such as Watershed Development Projects or MGNREGA through the Directorate of Soil Conservation & Watershed Development.
The farm pond must have a minimum water depth of 5 feet.
The farm pond must retain water for a minimum of 5 months of culture period.
While availing subsidy, the beneficiary family will be considered instead of an individual family member.
The assistance is limited to 0.5 acres of water spread area per beneficiary.
benefits_summary: One‑day training programme for beneficiaries and a one‑time financial subsidy (40% for General category, 60% for SC/ST/Women/Transgender/PwD) towards fish farming inputs.
